_comment: Reform-before-move demo: select the Spearmen and issue a form-up drag south. With reform-first on (the default) the regiment holds its ground for ~0.8 s while its ranks settle, then marches to the new line. Hold Space throughout to see the move path and formation preview during the reform pause.

overlap.reason: The clip deliberately films a large formation reshape at the new pitch identity; in-transit samples fire the grid metrics (same-owner bodies pass arbitrarily close mid-re-slot by design -- intra-regiment spacing is the formation arrival's job, not steering's -- and routes cross while the grid re-deals). Measured on the new-density re-pin: min neighbour 0.31 wu during the reform-then-march re-slot.
